raw_description:
You simply describe in everyday words what you want to create and the Journey Creation Agent builds the journey for you.

With Journey Creation Agent, you can:

  • Use an AI-powered, guided experience for optimized outcomes.
  • Build in minutes with no technical jargon, complex setup, or cold start. Use natural language to describe the journey you want to create.
  • Drive results–the agent interprets your goal and asks relevant follow-up questions to refine your intent and ensure accuracy.

Scenario

A campaign manager wants to re-engage inactive customers but has no time to build a journey from scratch. The manager simply types, “Send a re-engagement email to customers who haven’t purchased in 90 days, follow up with a reminder with a discount.” The journey is instantly generated, with the right audience, content, and structure.
title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Create journeys in minutes with Journey Creation Agent
